records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Product revenue accounted for 44% and 46% of our consolidated revenue for the three and six months ended June 30, 2022, as compared to 37% and 40% for the three and six months ended June 30, 2021.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The ongoing shift to the cloud, along with the widespread advancement of artificial intelligence (“AI”) across the data center, edge and Internet of Things (“IoT”) end points, has led to exponential growth in data usage and tremendous demands on data infrastructure.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Changes in operating assets and liabilities for the six months ended June 30, 2021, primarily included decreases in unbilled receivables, inventories, prepaids and other current assets and an increase in deferred revenue, offset by increases in accounts receivable, as well as decreases in income taxes payable and accrued salaries and benefits.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Cost of product revenue for the three months ended June 30, 2022, increased approximately $9.0 million as compared to the same period in 2021.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Cash provided by operating activities of $99.1 million for the six months ended June 30, 2022, was primarily attributable to the cash generated from customer licensing, product sales and engineering services fees.
